parsed.explanation: The padding claim is invalid: an arbitrary dummy piece does not make P∪R into a refinement of the specific bins B_{n-1}, so the inductive hypothesis cannot be invoked. Moreover D_rest is never precisely defined, and the asserted bound D_rest≤μ−1 is neither derived nor generally implied by the preceding inequalities. The later subcase and concluding remark likewise rely on unsupported parity, dummy-piece, or numerical claims rather than proving the universal lower bound for all n and all Xiang replies. Establishing L3.3 requires a genuine all-n lemma, such as the signed-sum/tree argument or the stated even-position majorization.
